_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (checked 2026-11-20). USD per million tokens, standard (global) rates. Haiku 5.5 rates apply to prompts up to 100K tokens.

strategies.label: Tiered classifier (Haiku / Sonnet / Opus)
strategies.description: Haiku judges each question and picks one of three models (llm_classifier, custom mode).

strategies.label: Task classifier (Haiku / Opus)
strategies.description: Haiku estimates whether the cheap model can solve it; otherwise Opus (llm_classifier, capability mode).

strategies.label: Auto (Stage router, Haiku / Opus)
strategies.description: Switchyard's default preset. Routes on tool-call signals, so plain chat stays on Haiku.
